title: Former Real Housewife Jen Shah Explains Guilty Fraud Plea and Says Ghislaine Maxwell Has “No Remorse” for Jeffrey Epstein Victims
summary: The ex-‘Real Housewives of Salt Lake City’ star sat down with People for her first interview since being released, where she said she’s “tak[ing] full responsibility” for her actions and also dished on her interactions with famous inmates including Maxwell and Elizabeth Holmes.
